newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CAPITAL MARKET COMMISSION IS AUTONOMOUS- FOTIADIS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CAPITAL MARKET COMMISSION IS AUTONOMOUS- FOTIADIS.

text.p: Greek National Economy Ministry General Secretary Apostolos Fotiadis said the stock market's reaction to capital market commissioner Stavros Thomadakis' warning last Wednesday was uncalled for.

"It was an innocent statement by commissioner Thomadakis and the three-session panic reaction was uncalled for," Fotiadis told Flash radio. "Nothing changed in the macroeconomic picture, the market's reaction was out of the blue."
Fotiadis said the capital market commission was an autonomous body although its members were appointed by the national economy minister.
Asked whether the ministry would hold anyone responsible for the market upset, Fotiadis said "this is up to the minister (Yannos Papandoniou)."

The Athens bourse lost 17 percent in three sessions following the commissioner's warning against rumour-based investment decisions. The market stabilised on Tuesday, settling 0.54 percent higher after volatile trading. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
